name: QualityClip
description: The quality of life Minecraft clipboard, notebook and reminder tool! Save chat clips (with {x} {y} {z} {biome} placeholders), write multi-page notes with real text selection and Scribble formatting, save sign text, and set reminders with snooze and daily/weekly repeat. Quick Clips grab your coordinates with one key press. Works with the Book & Quill and sign screens: copy a book or sign into a clip, or paste a clip back. Import and export everything as JSON. Open it with the K key, Mod Menu, or the button above the chat box.
